startingCard.title: Wilt Chamberlain dies
startingCard.subtitle: American basketball player
startingCard.fact: Wilton Norman Chamberlain was an American professional basketball player.

cards.title: ‘Equestrian Portrait of Charles V’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Titian
cards.fact: Equestrian Portrait of Charles V is an oil-on-canvas painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Titian.

cards.title: U2 opens
cards.subtitle: Rail line in Berlin, Germany
cards.fact: U2 is a line of the Berlin U-Bahn.

cards.title: Mother Teresa wins the Nobel Peace Prize
cards.fact: Mary Teresa Bojaxhiu, better known as Mother Teresa or Saint Mother Teresa, was an Albanian-Indian Catholic nun, founder of the Missionaries of Charity and a Catholic saint.

cards.title: James A. Garfield becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: James Abram Garfield was the 20th president of the United States, serving from March 1881 until his death in September that year after being shot in July.

cards.title: Social War of 91-87 BCE begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Social War, also called the Italian War or the Marsic War, was fought largely from 91 to 88 BC between the Roman Republic and several of its autonomous allies in Italy.

cards.title: Mughal Empire is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Mughal Empire was an early modern empire that ruled most of the Indian subcontinent.

cards.title: René Coty becomes president of France
cards.fact: Gustave Jules René Coty was President of France from 1954 to 1959.

cards.title: Kalinga War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Kalinga War was fought in ancient India between the Mauryan Empire under Ashoka the Great and Kalinga, an independent feudal kingdom located on the east coast, in the present-day state of Odisha and northern parts of Andhra Pradesh.

cards.title: Incandescent light bulb dates to
cards.subtitle: Invention or discovery
cards.fact: An incandescent light bulb, also known as an incandescent lamp or incandescent light globe, is an electric light that produces illumination by Joule heating a filament until it glows.

cards.title: Lok Bhavan is completed
cards.subtitle: Official residence of the Governor of West Bengal
cards.fact: Raj Bhavan, officially known as Lok Bhavan and formerly as Government House (1803–1950) is the official residence of the Governor of West Bengal, R.

cards.title: King Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud becomes King of Saudi Arabia
cards.fact: Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud was King of Saudi Arabia from 1964 until his assassination in 1975.

cards.title: Everton F.C. is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: Everton Football Club is a professional association football club based in Liverpool, England.

cards.title: François Truffaut dies
cards.subtitle: French film director
cards.fact: François Roland Truffaut was a French filmmaker, actor, and critic, who is widely regarded as one of the founders of the French New Wave.

cards.title: ‘12 Years a Slave’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Steve McQueen
cards.fact: 12 Years a Slave is a 2013 biographical historical drama film directed by Steve McQueen from a screenplay by John Ridley, based on the 1853 slave memoir Twelve Years a Slave by Solomon Northup, a Black American, who was kidnapped from Washington, D.C. by two conmen in 1841 and sold into slavery.

cards.title: Charles de Gaulle becomes president of France
cards.fact: Charles André Joseph Marie de Gaulle was a French general and statesman who led the Free French Forces against Nazi Germany and Vichy France in World War II and chaired the Provisional Government of the French Republic from 1944 to 1946 to restore democracy in France.

cards.title: ‘The Thing’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by John Carpenter
cards.fact: The Thing is a 1982 American science fiction horror film directed by John Carpenter from a screenplay by Bill Lancaster.

cards.title: Benvenuto Cellini dies
cards.subtitle: Florentine sculptor and goldsmith
cards.fact: Benvenuto Cellini was an Italian goldsmith, sculptor, and author.

cards.title: Lockheed XFV first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Lockheed Corporation
cards.fact: The Lockheed XFV is an American experimental tailsitter prototype aircraft built by Lockheed in the early 1950s to demonstrate the operation of a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) fighter for protecting convoys.

cards.title: ‘The Fate of the Furious’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by F. Gary Gray
cards.fact: The Fate of the Furious is a 2017 American action film directed by F.

cards.title: Mark 48 torpedo enters service
cards.subtitle: American heavyweight submarine-launched torpedoes
cards.fact: The Mark 48 and its improved Advanced Capability (ADCAP) variant are American heavyweight submarine-launched torpedoes.

cards.title: ‘Evolve’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Turtle Rock Studios
cards.fact: Evolve is a 2015 first-person shooter video game developed by Turtle Rock Studios and published by 2K.

cards.title: Western Han begins
cards.subtitle: Dynasty
cards.fact: The Han dynasty was an imperial dynasty of China established by Liu Bang, preceded by the Qin dynasty (221–206 BC) and a warring interregnum known as the Chu–Han Contention (206–202 BC), and succeeded by the Three Kingdoms period (220–280 AD).

cards.title: ‘Casino’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Martin Scorsese
cards.fact: Casino is a 1995 epic crime film directed by Martin Scorsese, adapted by Scorsese and Nicholas Pileggi from the latter's nonfiction book Casino: Love and Honor in Las Vegas.

cards.title: ‘Dragon Quest III’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Chunsoft
cards.fact: Dragon Quest III: The Seeds of Salvation, titled Dragon Warrior III when initially localized to North America, is a 1988 role-playing video game developed by Chunsoft and published by Enix.

cards.title: Tsutomu Hata becomes prime minister of Japan
cards.fact: Tsutomu Hata was a Japanese politician who briefly served as prime minister of Japan in 1994.

cards.title: ‘Dookie’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Green Day
cards.fact: Dookie is the third studio album and major-label debut by the American rock band Green Day, released on February 1, 1994, by Reprise Records.

cards.title: Lego is founded
cards.subtitle: Construction toy
cards.fact: Lego is a brand of plastic construction toys manufactured by the Lego Group, a privately held company based in Billund, Denmark.

cards.title: Torre Picasso is completed
cards.subtitle: Skyscraper in Madrid
cards.fact: Torre Picasso is a skyscraper in Madrid, Spain designed by Minoru Yamasaki.

cards.title: Anton Chekhov dies
cards.subtitle: Russian dramatist and author
cards.fact: Anton Pavlovich Chekhov was a Russian playwright and short story writer, widely considered one of the greatest writers of all time.

cards.title: ‘Vine’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Vine was a short-form video hosting service where users could share up to 6-second-long looping video clips.
